title: Mobile Wallet Pricing and Rate Disclosure Methodology
content:
Pricing methodology for **Mobile Wallet** transfers: how the transfer fee, the card funding fee, the exchange rate, the amount credited and the date available are disclosed at booking.

### Transfer fee
The transfer fee is the fee of the tier's fee band that contains the principal, less the tier's pay-by-bank fee discount when the transfer is funded by pay-by-bank, never below 0.00.

### First-transfer promotion
A first personal transfer is one booked when the sender account holds no other personal transfer in any delivery method, other than transfers whose status is cancelled or refunded. A first personal transfer booked on a tier that waives the transfer fee on a first transfer, with a principal at or below the tier's promotion cap, has a transfer fee of 0.00 and takes the tier's promotional margin. Above the cap the regular price applies to the whole transfer. The promotion never stacks with the pay-by-bank discount.

### Card funding fee
For credit-card funding the card funding fee is the tier's credit-card funding fee percentage of the principal, rounded half up to the cent; for debit-card funding it is the tier's flat debit-card funding fee.

### Margin, rate and amount credited
- The margin is the tier's exchange-rate margin, less the tier's reduction in percentage points when the principal is at or above the tier's reduction threshold. On a promoted first transfer the promotional margin replaces both.
- The exchange rate is the corridor's mid-market rate in the Paloma rate sheet for the booking date, multiplied by one minus the margin over 100, rounded half up to 4 decimals.
- The amount credited is the principal multiplied by that exchange rate, rounded half up to 2 decimals.

### Date available
The date available is the release day, counted from the tier's booking cut-off in the same way as for Bank Deposit transfers, plus the tier's number of Paloma business days to the date available. On a tier that credits on weekends and holidays the date may fall on any calendar day.

### Collection of fees
Fees are collected with the principal, as fee entries numbered 1 on the transfer's ledger.

## Worked figures (all inputs hypothetical)

| Case | Working | Disclosed |
|---|---|---|
| Mobile Wallet Express, principal 1500.00, credit card, not a first transfer, mid-market 56.0000 | band fee 4.99; card fee 3.00 percent of 1500.00 is 45.00; principal is at the 1500.00 threshold so the margin is 1.70 less 0.10, that is 1.60; rate is 56.0000 multiplied by 0.984, that is 55.1040; amount credited is 1500.00 multiplied by 55.1040 | fee 4.99, card fee 45.00, rate 55.1040, amount 82656.00 |
| Mobile Wallet Economy, first transfer, principal 800.00, ACH debit | principal at or below the 1000.00 cap | fee 0.00, promotional margin 0.00 |
| Mobile Wallet Economy, first transfer, principal 1200.00, ACH debit | above the cap: regular price on the whole transfer | fee 2.99, margin 1.15 |
| Mobile Wallet Express, first transfer, principal 300.00, pay-by-bank | promotion applies; it does not stack with the discount | fee 0.00 |
